# Hegemon UI Note: EU5 1.4.9 diplomacy_lateralview.gui hardcodes 2+3=5 hegemon slots
# (DataModelFirst(..., 2) + DataModelLast(..., 3)) and Main Mod already registers 7 hegemons.
# Silk Road Overland Hegemon & Scientific Luminary Hegemon are emitted here as prestigious
# Global Hegemon Edict Decisions + dynamic Great-Power Auto-Modifiers for zero UI glitches.

oe_v59_w5_dec_proclaim_silk_road_hegemon = {
	decision_category = economy_decisions
	hide_repeatable_tag = yes

	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		is_subject = no
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_v59_w5_proclaimed_silk_road_hegemon }
		any_owned_location = {
			OR = {
				region = region:persia_region
				region = region:khorasan_region
				region = region:xinjiang_region
				region = region:steppes_region
				region = region:north_china_region
				region = region:anatolia_region
				region = region:crescent_region
			}
		}
	}

	allow = {
		is_great_power = yes
		num_of_non_rural >= 10
		gold >= 300
		prestige >= 35
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_great_power = yes
				gold >= 600
				prestige >= 45
			}
			add = 50
		}
	}

	illustration_tags = { 10 = exterior }

	option = {
		name = oe_v59_w5_dec_proclaim_silk_road_hegemon.a
		effect = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_v59_w5_proclaimed_silk_road_hegemon value = 1 }
			add_gold = -300
			add_prestige = 15
			add_country_modifier = {
				modifier = oe_v59_w5_mod_silk_road_hegemon_edict
				years = 25
				mode = replace
			}
		}
	}
}

oe_v59_w5_dec_proclaim_scientific_hegemon = {
	decision_category = government_decisions
	hide_repeatable_tag = yes

	potential = {

		is_subject = no
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_v59_w5_proclaimed_scientific_hegemon }
	}

	allow = {
		is_great_power = yes
		average_country_literacy >= 25
		num_of_advances_researched >= 25
		gold >= 300
		prestige >= 35
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_great_power = yes
				gold >= 600
				prestige >= 45
			}
			add = 50
		}
	}

	illustration_tags = { 10 = interior }

	option = {
		name = oe_v59_w5_dec_proclaim_scientific_hegemon.a
		effect = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_v59_w5_proclaimed_scientific_hegemon value = 1 }
			add_gold = -300
			add_prestige = 15
			add_research_progress = 15
			add_country_modifier = {
				modifier = oe_v59_w5_mod_scientific_hegemon_edict
				years = 25
				mode = replace
			}
		}
	}
}
